text_block_list.text:
Since early childhood, Мэдзиро МакКуин
and
Мэдзиро Райан have always gotten
along well.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two of them watch a G1 race
together. They
observe the strong will of
the racers on the track
and reflect on
themselves.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They're reminded of the strength they
will need to
truly take on the Classics.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
